decision: Pay the complete finite cost of the accepted continual-learning demonstration and its provider-service validation, with no assumed NEURO cash value.
funding: Operator-authorized AWS research sponsorship; no public token sales or external customer revenue assumed.

scope.provider_allocations: All provider-service attempts on September 19, including rejected setups and the final corrective attempt; preserve each original frozen cap and outcome.
scope.controllers: Both existing m5.xlarge hosts over the measurement interval, conservatively charging their complete observed footprint although they also run older services.
scope.compute: Every allocated second through confirmed retirement, including setup, rejected work, idle time, training, generation, full verification and cleanup.
scope.storage: All allocated GPU disks and existing controller disks over the interval. Deduplicate the public research object pool; cost 93 days of retained artifacts, including failed attempts and source/evidence archives.
scope.network: Raw complete EC2 NetworkIn/NetworkOut series for retired learning allocations and controllers; complete per-host non-loopback counters for provider allocations. Price both measured directions at USD 0.15 per decimal GB, deliberately including free traffic.

inherited_inputs: Published seed models and research checkpoints are starting assets. Their historical research before this measurement interval is not claimed to have been produced by this budget.

native_rules.training: Only settled unique prescribed updates issue rewards under each frozen native manifest. This sponsorship cannot change an issuance schedule or advance serving quality.
native_rules.inference: No new issuance. Customers prepay bounded execution, provider fees and complete verification; native settlement refunds unused escrow.
native_rules.verification: Native voting-weight quorum, with every honest positive or negative report based on complete replay. Different keys and fresh executions do not establish independent administration.
native_rules.serving_limit: Only the declared inference-only provider trials; no open-ended public serving subsidy or new training cohort is authorized by this experiment file.

stops: Preserve each allocation hard deadline and protected hosts.
Do not launch further corrective trials if their conservative estimate exceeds the remaining aggregate sponsorship.
Retire disposable hosts and volumes after evidence collection.
No future cohort, indefinite artifact growth or perpetual inference is covered. A new finite policy is required before extending these obligations.
accounting: Price-based pre-tax conservative estimates, not billed usage. Cost Explorer access is unavailable. Earlier individual caps remain auditable even if a later complete estimate exceeds them; this aggregate policy does not relabel an earlier failed cap as passed.
not_demonstrated: Cheap cryptographic proof of neural execution
